text:
The $1,500,000 already spent is a sunk cost. It is gone whether we continue or stop, so it is irrelevant to the decision from today forward.

Option - stop now:
Sell work for $60,000, no further cost.
Expected value from today = $60,000.

Option - continue:
Pay $200,000 more to finish.
Expected gross return if finished = 0.30 * $800,000 + 0.70 * $50,000
= $240,000 + $35,000
= $275,000.
Expected net value from today = $275,000 - $200,000 = $75,000.

Compare from today: $75,000 continue > $60,000 stop.
So the expected-value-maximizing decision is to continue.

{"choice": "continue", "value": 75000}
